newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Investment agreement for EML completed.
newsitem.headline: Investment agreement for EML completed.

text.p: An investment agreement for the sale of ailing video cassette maker Electro Magnetics (1992) Ltd (EML) has been completed, the company's judicial managers said on Monday.

The agreement saw Panwell Pte Ltd issue a standby letter of credit for Singapore $8.0 million which EML could draw on if Panwell failed to complete the acquisition, a statement from the judicial managers said.
But it warned shareholders: "The making of any takeover is still uncertain at this stage".
Shareholders are expected to get 16.8 cents per share if the plan goes through in a deal worth S$88 million announced on December 30.
The rescue plan was put together by businessman Joseph Gondobintoro, a Singapore permanent resident with extensive Indonesian business interests.
At that time, Gondobintoro agreed to sign a deal to acquire EML through his Panwell investment vehicle by January 31.
